fixes.explanation: That's not what Joel describes. The nations writhe in horror, and every face turns pale. He doesn't say anyone rushes out to fight. I think I'd be frozen with fear too, gold base and all.

Right, baker. Joel says "…consecrate a fast, proclaim a sacred assembly." The horn is calling for people to come together before the LORD. Verse 1 also has a ram's horn blowing in Zion, and here it has a different job.
